Query example:
```sql
-- Top repos by stars
SELECT full_name, language, stars, pushed_at 
FROM repo_snapshots ORDER BY stars DESC LIMIT 10;

-- GF3 color chain
SELECT id, gf3_trit, gf3_color, gf3_name, source_name 
FROM world_increments ORDER BY id;

-- Multisig health
SELECT pair, sigs_required, healthy FROM multisig_probes;
```
